defects.finding: The production browser handoff body included an idempotency key, but the HTTP Idempotency-Key header was missing.
defects.direct_before: Explicit submit failed with: The Idempotency-Key header must match the reviewed handoff packet.
defects.repair: A single handoff builder now binds the packet key and request header and derives localhost URLs from window.location.origin.

defects.finding: Ephemeral source retention removed the exact TS-CORE-01 message immediately after proposal creation.
defects.direct_before: The source block and all four exact-evidence links rendered empty quotes.
defects.repair: The reviewed selected text now requests evidence_crop; source-retention.v2 returns effective reviewed_selected_text scope and an explicit deadline.

defects.finding: A long mixed English/Chinese correction with a URL and unbroken token widened the 390px document to 1675px.
defects.repair: Evidence, confirmed values, action previews, provenance, authority, and readback text now allow emergency wrapping.

defects.finding: The Web gate treated dismissed facts as sufficient for action approval while the backend correctly required every action-bound assertion to be confirmed.
defects.direct_before: Approve exact local effect was exposed and rejected with Every assertion required by this action must be independently confirmed.
defects.repair: Authority now derives from the action's exact required_assertion_ids and explains why a dismissed requirement blocks the proposal.

defects.finding: Repeated links to the same exact source could leave the already-active hash target off-screen.
defects.repair: Every fact and action evidence link now reopens and focuses the exact source figure.

unresolved_proof_gaps: XS-CAPTURE-01 extension capture and pre-Submit silence.
